GOVERNMENT OF PUNJAB
DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES
NOTIFICATION
The 24th October, 2025
No.WR-IRWR04/37/2023-IW3/2051.- In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 38 of Punjab
Canal and Drainage Act, 2023, read with Section 2 of the aforesaid Act, the Governor of Punjab is pleased to
notify the Khasra numbers as per details given below for the smooth flow of Water in “Mehangrowal Choe”.
The Governor of Punjab is further pleased to authorize the Executive Engineer/Hoshiarpur, Drainage-
cum-Mining Division, WRD, Punjab, District Hoshiarpur, to take all necessary to remove obstructions, in case
any such obstructions are raised by any person. The Concerned officer i.e., Executive Engineer/Hoshiarpur,
Drainage-cum-Mining Division, WRD, Punjab, District Hoshiarpur, may also authorize any other Government
officer or any private person to remove such obstructions or carry out any activities for the aforesaid purpose.
